sloka: महा इन्द्र ध्वज सम्काशः क्व नु शेते महा भुजः ।भुजम् परिघ सम्काशम् उपधाय महा बलः ॥२-६१-७॥
transliteration: mahā indra dhvaja samkāśaḥ kva nu śete mahā bhujaḥ ।bhujam parigha samkāśam upadhāya mahā balaḥ ॥2-61-7॥

translations.english: Where will that mightyarmed and powerful Rama, as lofty as Indra's banner, sleep using his ironbarlike arm as pillow?.
